tools.description: Reveal a creator contact address. Costs 1 prepaid credit the first time this organization reveals that profile. Later calls return the address without charging. Needs a credential.

Runs one creator search (same daily grant and prepaid credits as search_creators; pre-claim agent tokens spend prepaid credits only) and saves matches; idempotent on (campaign, profileId). Optional filters narrow the search. Holds the call open until

Stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of the catalog profile and keeps only profileId and fitScore from the input; a profileId with no catalog profile returns not_found. While a send request

tools.name: add_campaign_matches

tools.name: remove_campaign_match
tools.description: Remove one matched creator from a campaign by match id. A match that already has a proposal delivery, or any match while a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

tools.name: list_campaign_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a campaign of the caller's organization, with id, filename, content type, byte size, and upload time. Returns no file contents. A campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

tools.name: delete_campaign_attachment
tools.description: Delete one file attached to a campaign of the caller's organization. Irreversible. An attachment or a campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

tools.name: export_campaign
tools.description: Export a campaign as CSV (Rank, Handle, Name, Platform, Followers, Fit, Source). Same access as get_campaign. Needs a credential.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the current credential, the bound user and organization, and whether the next search draws from the user daily grant or the organization balance. Needs a credential.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Read the prepaid credit balance, the identified daily search grant status, the last pack, and whether a card is on file. Does not start checkout or change payment settings. Needs a credential.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List API keys for the active organization (id, name, prefix, timestamps). An owner or admin sees every key; a member sees only the keys they minted. Never returns plaintext keys. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Mint a new API key. Returns the plaintext key once; store it immediately. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by id. An owner or admin revokes any key of the organization; a member revokes only a key they minted, and another key returns not_found. Irreversible. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

tools.name: thread_turn
tools.description: Run the next turn of a search thread and return the settled brief, its filters, the operations the turn ran, the reply, and the creators of the thread result set with a shortlist enrichment ticket. Omit threadId to open a new thread; the threadId in the result is the durable handle for the next turn

tools.name: intersect_lists
tools.description: Keep the creators that appear in both lists, in the order of the left list. Nothing is stored. Map a search_creators result to the saved creator shape first: profileId is the creator id, and fitScore, followerCount, name, platform, profileImageUrl, and username carry over. Needs a credential.

tools.name: save_list
tools.description: Save a set of creators as a List for the organization, with the brief and filters of the search that produced it. The List takes the name in name, or a name cut from the brief when name is omitted, with a number from 2 appended when another List of the organization holds that name. Map a search_crea

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the organization's saved Lists with brief, filters, creatorCount (each person once), itemCount (each saved profile), and last update. Needs a credential.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get one List of the caller's organization with its brief, filters, and saved creators, best fit first. The creators carry the saved creator shape that add_campaign_matches, create_campaign, and intersect_lists take. A List outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete one List of the caller's organization and its saved creators. Campaigns keep the creators added from it. Irreversible. A List outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_creators, enrich_creators, get_campaign, thread_turn · Private data: search_creators, reveal_contact, list_campaigns, get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, delete_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, delete_campaign_attachment, export_campaign, send_campaign, fund_campaign, whoami, get_credits, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, thread_turn, intersect_lists, save_list, list_lists, get_list, delete_list · Public sink: get_campaign, update_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, send_campaign · Destructive: enrich_creators, delete_campaign, remove_campaign_match, delete_campaign_attachment, thread_turn, delete_list.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
